content.title: Who Let The Dogs Out

alternatives.text: "Who Let the Dogs Out," the 2000 hit by Baha Men, is a captivating fusion of reggae, pop, and dancehall elements. This infectious anthem, originally penned by Anslem Douglas as a feminist critique of catcalling, transcends its origins to become an enduring dance floor classic. Its catchy refrain and vibrant rhythms have cemented its place in popular culture. A testament.
